scene.kickoff.open: {ref} gets things under way. {home} against {away}, the ball is rolling.

Proper winter weather! They are playing with the orange ball.

{ref} restarts the game. 45 minutes to go.
scene.halfTime.level: Half-time at {score}. Everything is still to play for.

scene.halfTime.open: {ref} blows for the break with {score} on the scoreboard.

A game people will be talking about for a while.

scene.extraTimeSecondHalf.open: The final quarter of an hour of extra time begins.

{p} takes a deep breath and runs up ...

A step-over from {p} and {o} falls for it!
{p} leaves {o} behind with a sharp cut inside.

Applause from the stands for that bit of skill.
scene.cross.ball: {p} curls a cross into the box ...

scene.aerial.win: {p} rises highest and wins the header against {o}.

{p} times the jump perfectly and flicks it on.

{def} cuts off the route and wins the ball.

scene.shot.freeKick: The free kick from {p} has plenty of curl ...

scene.save.reflex: An incredible reflex from {g}, that looked certain to go in!
{g} throws up a hand, what a reaction!
scene.save.penalty: Saved! {g} stays big and grabs it.

scene.blocked.body: {def} throws themselves in the way and blocks!
